body: Research synthesis (2026-11-25): Production routers use rule-first or high-confidence fast paths before LLM classifiers (Compile N Run; AWS routing workflow). Abstain or low-margin routes fall back to general handler (proagenticworkflows.ai). Multi-agent papers recommend bypassing full supervisor when a fast classifier is confident (arXiv 2412.05449). Our v1 always calls LLM triage (~5s) then branch-specific pipelines (research ~49s). See docs/supervisor-improvement-backlog.md.
